text:
maria: FYI provisioning just stalled in eu-central. ~40% of the batch nodes are stuck in 'awaiting-bmc' after the firmware push, BMCs flapping, and we've seen secure-boot toggle to 'default' on a subset :warning:

james: ugh. what's the capacity hit?

maria: GPUs reported available 120 -> 72, lots of failed agent checkins. most failures show IPMI session resets around the same time window.

sophie: can you paste the last ipmitool output? also, which fw version rolled?

maria: roll started at 2435678800, fw v2.3.1 -> v2.4.0. infra-bot posted the rollout. here's a sample from one node:
```
# ipmitool -I lanplus -H 10.12.34.56 -U admin -P **** chassis status
Chassis Power is on
System Event Log is not supported
Sensor 0x1: IPMI session disconnected, sensor read fail
```

liam: seeing similar on canary group but not all. looks like a race between the fw reboot and our BMC agent reconnect loop; KV cache population gets interrupted which then leaves the node 'provisioner-unready'.

ops-nora: region constraints: eu-central is our primary for this tenant pool, we can't easily drain to us-west due to reserved capacity and network egress costs. shifting jobs will blow monthly commit.

james: so options: 1) pause the rollout and roll back v2.3.1 2) apply an emergency mitigation to bypass secure-boot enforcement server-side for affected nodes 3) stagger reboots with longer wait/backoff in the agent

sophie: prefer pause + rollback. bypassing secure-boot checks is risky for compliance teams. if rollback isn't immediate, we should at least increase BMC reconnect backoff to avoid session storms.

maria: pausing now for the remaining hosts in eu-central. rolling back can start if ops approves. infra-bot: pause-rollout eu-central v2.4.0

infra-bot: action acknowledged: pause-rollout eu-central v2.4.0 by @maria at 2435678945

liam: I'll push a quick agent patch to increase ipmi reconnect backoff from 2s -> 12s and a jitter to avoid thundering herd. small binary, can be live-updated via the agent hook.

ops-nora: approve rollback but need canary verification plan. rollback 10% first, validate secure-boot state + KV cache fill for 30m, if green continue. we also need a cost note for the execs about potential capacity loss if we delay.

maria: noted. starting rollback canary (10 nodes) at 2435678970. will post logs.

james: add an alert for secure-boot state flips to prod monitoring (metric: bmc.secureboot.state.change) and a dashboard showing ipmi session reset rate per rack.

sophie: i'll draft the runbook update: include the ipmitool commands, reconnect backoff param, and a checklist for compliance if secure-boot was toggled. also add steps to verify KV cache via `curl -s http://localhost:8080/kvstatus | jq .`

maria: thanks all. immediate next steps: pause rollout (done), start 10-node rollback canary (in progress), liam will push agent backoff patch, sophie will update runbook. i'll follow up with a short postmortem once we stabilize. :white_check_mark:
